mistwood_village_outskirts.title: Hidden Cave of the Silver-Tailed Fox
mistwood_village_outskirts.text: You find a moss-covered cave beneath an ancient cedar. Inside, a silver-tailed fox sleeps beside a jade chest.

mistwood_village_outskirts.title: Bandit Roadblock
mistwood_village_outskirts.text: Three ragged cultivators block the path, demanding spirit stones for passage.

mistwood_village_outskirts.title: Hidden Herb Garden
mistwood_village_outskirts.text: A small clearing bathed in moonlight grows spirit herbs. Some are ready to harvest.

mistwood_village_outskirts.title: Abandoned Shrine
mistwood_village_outskirts.text: A small shrine to a forgotten earth spirit offers a moment of peace. Qi flows gently here.

mistwood_village_outskirts.title: Wounded Traveler
mistwood_village_outskirts.text: A young cultivator lies injured on the path, their leg caught in a beast trap. They beg for help.

mistwood_village_outskirts.title: Fox Spirit's Illusion
mistwood_village_outskirts.text: The path ahead shimmers. A fox spirit weaves illusion mist, trying to lead you into a bog.

mistwood_village_outskirts.title: Ancient Hunting Trap
mistwood_village_outskirts.text: You step on a hidden formation disk. Ropes of light spring up, attempting to bind your limbs.

mistwood_village_outskirts.title: Echo of the First Breath
mistwood_village_outskirts.text: A breeze carries the faint sound of a single note — the first breath of a cultivator who passed through a century ago. The dao lingers.

bamboo_grove.title: Bamboo Serpent Ambush
bamboo_grove.text: A massive emerald serpent drops from the canopy, its scales humming with wood qi.

bamboo_grove.title: Sword-Scarred Bamboo
bamboo_grove.text: A grove of bamboo stalks bears deep cuts — sword intent frozen in the grain after a duel decades past.

choices.label: Match Your Blade to the Scar

bamboo_grove.title: Bamboo Spirit Glade
bamboo_grove.text: The bamboo parts to reveal a glade where motes of green qi drift lazily. A spirit of the grove regards you.

bamboo_grove.title: Wind-Whipped Rope Bridge
bamboo_grove.text: A fraying rope bridge stretches across a deep ravine. Wind howls through the gorge below.

bamboo_grove.title: Ancient Sword Hilt
bamboo_grove.text: Half-buried in bamboo roots, a sword hilt carved with cloud patterns catches your eye.

bamboo_grove.title: Wandering Merchant
bamboo_grove.text: A merchant cultivator sits by the path, their cart overturned. Spirit beasts circle nearby.

bamboo_grove.title: Bamboo Formation Trap
bamboo_grove.text: The bamboo shifts around you — someone set a trapping formation. Sharpened stakes spring from the earth.

choices.label: Wait for the Qi to Settle

bamboo_grove.title: Moonlight Pond
bamboo_grove.text: A still pond reflects the moon. The water hums with ambient qi, gentle and inviting.

ashen_cliff.title: Volcanic Herb Ledge
ashen_cliff.text: On a precarious ledge above molten rock, fire-adapted herbs glow with inner heat.

ashen_cliff.title: Fire Beast Lair
ashen_cliff.text: A cave mouth glows orange. Inside, a beast wreathed in embers gnaws on spirit ore.

choices.label: Lure It Out and Sneak In

ashen_cliff.title: Raiders' Outpost
ashen_cliff.text: A crude outpost blocks the cliff pass. Fire path raiders have claimed this territory.

ashen_cliff.title: Ash Spring
ashen_cliff.text: A hot spring steams amid black stone. The mineral-rich water carries fire qi.

ashen_cliff.title: Falling Boulders
ashen_cliff.text: The cliff path trembles. Loose boulders tumble from above, kicked loose by something larger.

ashen_cliff.title: Rogue Cultivator Ambush
ashen_cliff.text: A rogue cultivator steps from behind a pillar of ash, blade drawn. 'Your qi feels rich. Share it.'

ashen_cliff.title: Ancient Fire Formation
ashen_cliff.text: You step into a circle of black stone. Ember runes ignite — a meditation formation from a fire path elder long passed.

ashen_cliff.title: Ash Phantom
ashen_cliff.text: Ash swirls into a humanoid shape — the remnant of a cultivator who died here. It reaches for you.

moonwell_ruins.title: Moonwell Reflecting Pool
moonwell_ruins.text: A basin of silver water reflects not your face, but a version of you from another life — one who chose differently.

moonwell_ruins.title: Ghost Sentry
moonwell_ruins.text: A translucent armored figure bars the entrance to a collapsed hall. It speaks: 'State your purpose.'

moonwell_ruins.title: Soul Treasure Chamber
moonwell_ruins.text: A sealed chamber hums with yin qi. Inside, jade slips and soul pearls rest on an altar.

moonwell_ruins.title: Crumbling Hallway
moonwell_ruins.text: The stone floor groans. Pressure plates from an ancient security system activate beneath your feet.

choices.label: Go Back and Find Another Path

moonwell_ruins.title: Moonlit Courtyard
moonwell_ruins.text: Moonlight pools in a ruined courtyard. The yin qi here is thick and soothing.

moonwell_ruins.title: Ghost Child
moonwell_ruins.text: A translucent child sits on a broken pillar, weeping. They were a disciple here, long ago.

choices.label: Demand to Know the Ruins' Secrets

moonwell_ruins.title: Yin Spring Vein
moonwell_ruins.text: A crack in the earth leaks concentrated yin qi, condensed into droplets of liquid moonlight.

moonwell_ruins.title: Formation Puzzle
moonwell_ruins.text: A circular formation of nine tiles blocks the path. Each tile bears a different moon phase.

verdant_depths.title: Ancient Tree Guardian
verdant_depths.text: A massive ancient tree stirs. Its roots snake toward you as a face forms in the bark.

verdant_depths.title: Sunken Herb Garden
verdant_depths.text: A collapsed section of the forest floor reveals a garden of rare shade-grown herbs.

verdant_depths.title: Deep Forest Shrine
verdant_depths.text: A moss-covered shrine to the spirit of the deep woods offers shelter. The air is calm and safe.

verdant_depths.title: Silkweb Spider Ambush
verdant_depths.text: Sticky silk strands fall from the canopy. A massive spider descends, mandibles dripping with venom.

verdant_depths.title: Spirit Beast Tracks
verdant_depths.text: Fresh tracks in the mud — a large spirit beast passed through recently. The trail leads to a thicket.

verdant_depths.title: Poison Fog Valley
verdant_depths.text: A valley below is filled with pale green mist. Even from here, your lungs burn.

choices.label: Wait for the Wind to Shift

verdant_depths.title: Verdant Dao Resonance
verdant_depths.text: The forest hums. Every leaf trembles in harmony. A moment of profound connection to the wood dao.

choices.label: Open Your Heart to the Forest

verdant_depths.title: Hollow Tree Cache
verdant_depths.text: A colossal hollow tree contains a hidden cache — someone's long-abandoned storage.

cursed_swamp.title: Corpse Leech Pool
cursed_swamp.text: A stagnant pool writhes with corpse leeches, drawn by the heat of living qi.

cursed_swamp.title: Will-o'-Wisp
cursed_swamp.text: A blue flame dances ahead, leading deeper into the swamp. Following it may lead to treasure — or a bog grave.

cursed_swamp.title: Flooded Ruin
cursed_swamp.text: Half-submerged stone walls mark a forgotten shrine. Something glints beneath the dark water.

cursed_swamp.title: Swamp Gas Bog
cursed_swamp.text: Bubbles rise from the mud. The air is thick with flammable swamp gas — one wrong spark could end you.

choices.label: Dispel the Gas with Wind Qi
Go Back and Find Another Route

cursed_swamp.title: Cursed Altar
cursed_swamp.text: A bloodstained altar pulses with demonic qi. A sealed manual lies on it — but touching it will curse you.

choices.label: Leave Before the Curse Takes Hold

cursed_swamp.title: Bog Beast Lair
cursed_swamp.text: A mound of mud and reeds shifts. A bog beast rises, caked in centuries of swamp sediment.

cursed_swamp.title: Dry Mound Refuge
cursed_swamp.text: A rare patch of dry earth rises from the bog. A few stunted trees provide shade.

cursed_swamp.title: Swamp Dao Echo
cursed_swamp.text: A moment of stillness. The swamp's corruption and life force are one — a lesson in balance.

sword_tomb.title: Sword Guardian Spirit
sword_tomb.text: A spirit clad in rusted armor rises, gripping a broken blade. It challenges all who enter.

sword_tomb.title: Field of Broken Blades
sword_tomb.text: Hundreds of shattered swords jut from the earth. Sword intent lingers in each fragment.

sword_tomb.title: Sword Tomb Rest Chamber
sword_tomb.text: An intact chamber with a stone bed and a quiet fountain. Ancient duelists once rested here.

sword_tomb.title: Falling Swords Trap
sword_tomb.text: You trigger a pressure plate. Ancient mechanisms release a volley of rusted blades from the ceiling.

sword_tomb.title: Sword Technique Stele
sword_tomb.text: A black stone stele bears the carving of a single sword stance. The intent radiates like heat.

sword_tomb.title: Ghost Duelist
sword_tomb.text: A translucent swordsman blocks your path. They were a tomb guardian in life and still guard their post.

sword_tomb.title: Tomb Armory
sword_tomb.text: A collapsed armory contains rusted but salvageable weapons and armor.

sword_tomb.title: Sword Intent Corridor
sword_tomb.text: A long corridor lined with sword marks. Each step intensifies the pressure of lingering sword intent.

choices.label: Turn Back and Find Another Path

spirit_vein_mine.title: Unstable Qi Vein
spirit_vein_mine.text: The ground hums with raw qi. A cracked spirit vein pulses erratically — one wrong step could trigger a burst.

spirit_vein_mine.title: Earth Beast Tunnel
spirit_vein_mine.text: A grinding sound echoes from a side tunnel. An earth beast with crystal hide blocks the way.

spirit_vein_mine.title: Rich Spirit Stone Deposit
spirit_vein_mine.text: A wall of crystalline spirit stones, pure and dense. A fortune in raw stone.

spirit_vein_mine.title: Runaway Mine Cart
spirit_vein_mine.text: A mine cart loaded with ore breaks loose on the tracks, hurtling toward you.

spirit_vein_mine.title: Collapsed Shaft
spirit_vein_mine.text: The tunnel ahead has collapsed. The ceiling groans — more may fall.

spirit_vein_mine.title: Hidden Miner's Cavern
spirit_vein_mine.text: An abandoned miner's break room, still stocked with dried rations and a jug of water.

choices.label: Take What's Useful and Move On

spirit_vein_mine.title: Underground River
spirit_vein_mine.text: An underground river blocks the deepest tunnel. The current is strong but the water glows with qi.

spirit_vein_mine.title: Earth Vein Dao Resonance
spirit_vein_mine.text: Deep in the mine, you feel the pulse of the earth vein itself — the dao of patience and pressure.

choices.label: Merge Your Qi with the Vein

crimson_lotus_lake.title: Lotus Spirit
crimson_lotus_lake.text: A lotus spirit rises from the water, its petals sharp as blades. It guards the heart of the lake.

choices.label: Offer a Drop of Blood Qi

crimson_lotus_lake.title: Illusion Mist Shore
crimson_lotus_lake.text: Pink mist rolls across the shore. Visions of desire and fear flicker within — the lake testing your heart.

choices.label: Close Your Eyes and Walk Blind

crimson_lotus_lake.title: Blood Moon Altar
crimson_lotus_lake.text: A stone altar sits on a small island, bathed in crimson moonlight. Ancient symbols pulse with power.

crimson_lotus_lake.title: Crimson Herb Garden
crimson_lotus_lake.text: Beneath the lake's surface, luminous crimson herbs grow in beds of volcanic sand.

crimson_lotus_lake.title: Fire and Water Geyser
crimson_lotus_lake.text: A geyser of steam and fire qi erupts periodically. The ground is cracked and unstable.

crimson_lotus_lake.title: Lake Islet
crimson_lotus_lake.text: A small islet rises from the lake, covered in soft moss. The mingled fire and water qi here is surprisingly harmonious.

crimson_lotus_lake.title: Drowned Cultivator's Remains
crimson_lotus_lake.text: The bones of a cultivator rest at the lake bottom, their storage ring still intact.

crimson_lotus_lake.title: Lotus Dance
crimson_lotus_lake.text: A group of lake spirits dance on the water's surface. They beckon you to join — but the dance is a test.

heavenfall_peak.title: Lightning Beast
heavenfall_peak.text: A beast crackling with lightning energy prowls the peak. Its eyes glow with heavenly tribulation fire.

heavenfall_peak.title: Heavenly Pressure Field
heavenfall_peak.text: An invisible pressure crushes down — remnant heavenly tribulation energy. Every step is a battle.

choices.label: Find the Calm Eye of the Field

heavenfall_peak.title: Fallen Dao Mark
heavenfall_peak.text: A cracked boulder bears the palm print of a cultivator who attempted heavenly tribulation here — and failed. Their dao lingers.

heavenfall_peak.title: Heavenfall Cache
heavenfall_peak.text: Wedged in a cliff crevice, a sealed chest bears the mark of a heaven-defying cultivator.

heavenfall_peak.title: Lightning Storm Shelter
heavenfall_peak.text: A cave behind a waterfall offers shelter from the lightning storm raging above.

heavenfall_peak.title: Heavenly Thunder Echo
heavenfall_peak.text: Thunder rolls across the peak. Each peal carries a fragment of heavenly law — if you can understand it.

heavenfall_peak.title: Cliffside Path
heavenfall_peak.text: The only path forward is a narrow ledge along a sheer cliff. Wind howls, threatening to throw you off.

heavenfall_peak.title: Echo of a Heaven-Defier
heavenfall_peak.text: A spectral figure stands atop the peak — the echo of a cultivator who reached for immortality and was struck down. It turns to face you.
